title: Track a card delivery
text: For a card that has not arrived, open Cards, select the ordered card, then choose Track delivery. If the tracking page has no delivery estimate, contact support through the app chat.

title: Lost or stolen card
text: If a card is lost or stolen, freeze the card immediately in Cards. Then choose Replace card to order a replacement. Never share your PIN or security code in the support chat.

title: ATM did not dispense cash
text: If an ATM debited your account but did not dispense cash, open the withdrawal in Transactions and choose Report ATM issue. Include the ATM location and withdrawal time. Do not retry the withdrawal to resolve the missing cash.

title: Card payment is pending
text: A pending card payment is a merchant authorization and has not settled. Open the payment in Transactions to view its status. Ask the merchant to cancel the authorization if the purchase was cancelled; contact support if you need help checking the status.

title: Bank transfer is pending
text: For a pending bank transfer, open Transfers and select the transfer to check its status. Verify the recipient details. If the details are correct and you still need help, share the transfer reference with support through the app chat.

title: Bank transfer failed
text: For a failed bank transfer, open Transfers and read the failure reason. Correct the recipient details before sending again. If the balance has not been restored, contact support with the transfer reference.

title: Unrecognized card payment
text: If you do not recognize a card payment, freeze the card first. Open the payment in Transactions and choose Report unrecognized payment. Provide the transaction reference through the app chat; never send your full card number.

title: Check a cash withdrawal fee
text: To check a cash withdrawal fee, open the withdrawal in Transactions and read Fee details. The app shows the applied fee and the ATM operator charge separately. This knowledge base does not specify fee amounts or free withdrawal limits.

title: Change the registered phone number
text: To change your registered phone number, open Profile, then Personal details, then Phone number. Complete the identity verification shown in the app. If you cannot access your old number, choose I cannot access this number to contact support.

title: View a forgotten card PIN
text: If you forgot a card PIN, open Cards, select the card, and choose View PIN. Complete the app authentication. Support will never ask you to send or read out the PIN.

title: Track a merchant refund
text: To track a merchant refund, open the original purchase in Transactions and check the refund status. If the merchant confirms a refund that is not visible, contact support with the merchant refund reference. This knowledge base does not promise a refund deadline.

title: Download an account statement
text: To download an account statement, open Accounts, select the account, choose Statements, then select a date range and Download PDF. Keep the document private because it contains personal account information.
